Truly transparent background throughout, including between cells, no checkerboard pattern, no black or white filled background, no grid lines, no letters, no labels, no UI, no numbers, no characters. Generous transparent gutters at least 40 pixels inside EACH cell, absolutely no effect touching any cell boundary.
